note: Presentation model: which discovery pathways the homepage's Community Resources column offers, and in what order. This is NOT the domain model. A pathway with kind='category' MUST reference a key that exists in taxonomy.json, which stays the single source of truth for the vocabulary -- its label and icon are resolved from there rather than repeated here, so the two can never drift. A pathway with kind='discovery' is a controlled query over existing CivicContent metadata and carries its own label/icon precisely because it is NOT a category and must not be added to taxonomy.json. The homepage deliberately shows a curated subset; every category remains reachable through Discover. Editors may reorder, add or remove entries here without a code change.
